note: Single source of truth for the Digitalaikart Apps store. tools/build_apps.py reads this file and generates /apps/index.html plus one page per app at /apps/<slug>/. Add an entry here (and drop icon/screenshots into /apps/icons and /apps/shots) to publish an app. Never delete existing entries.

apps.name: Neon Calculator
apps.tagline: A colourful, kid-friendly calculator with glowing neon buttons.
apps.description:
Neon Calculator is a bright, playful calculator built for kids and anyone who wants maths to feel fun. Every key glows in neon, the buttons are big and easy to hit, and the whole app works fully offline with no ads and no sign-up.

It is small, fast and free — the perfect first calculator on a child's phone or tablet.

apps.name: Neon Piano + Calculator
apps.tagline: A neon piano and a calculator in one playful app.
apps.description:
Neon Piano + Calculator puts a glowing neon piano and a full calculator in the same app. Tap the colourful keys to play, or switch to the calculator when you need to do some maths.

It is built to be fun and simple — great for kids, quick tunes, and everyday sums. Works offline, with no ads.

apps.name: Car Simulator
apps.tagline: A top-down open-city car driving simulator for Android.
apps.description:
Car Simulator is a smooth top-down driving game set in an open city. Cruise the streets, take corners, and enjoy simple, responsive driving built on a custom engine made for Android phones.

It runs offline, loads fast, and is light on storage — a quick driving fix without the ads or the wait.
features: Open city map to drive around

apps.name: GrabIt
apps.tagline: An all-in-one media downloader, browser and phone cleaner.
apps.description:
GrabIt bundles three everyday tools into one clean app: a fast in-app browser, a media downloader, and a phone cleaner that frees up space. Browse, save what you need, and tidy your storage without hopping between apps.

It is designed to be simple and quick, with no clutter and no ads.

apps.name: MediaVault
apps.tagline: A privacy-focused media downloader and player.
apps.description:
MediaVault keeps your saved videos and music in one private place. Download media, store it in your own vault, and play it back offline — away from prying eyes and without ads.

It is built around privacy first: your library stays on your device.

apps.name: SoulStream
apps.tagline: A gamer-grade media downloader with a neon animated UI.
apps.description:
SoulStream is a media downloader built with a bold, neon, gamer-style interface. It browses, downloads and plays back media with speed and flair, and it stays ad-free.

Fast downloads, an animated UI, and a built-in player — all in one app.

apps.name: OmniTask AI
apps.tagline: Give tasks to any AI — OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Sarvam or your own.
apps.description:
OmniTask AI lets you send a task to the AI of your choice — OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Sarvam, or a custom endpoint — from one clean app. Bring your own API key and switch models whenever you like.

It is a single, tidy workspace for all your AI tools, without juggling browser tabs.

apps.name: PulseChat
apps.tagline: A simple chat app with unique usernames and friends.
apps.description:
PulseChat is a lightweight chat app where you pick a unique username and add friends to talk with. Sign in with Google and start chatting in a clean, distraction-free interface.

It is built to be simple and friendly — no clutter, no noise.

apps.name: TwinSpace
apps.tagline: Run a second copy of any app in an isolated space.
apps.description:
TwinSpace lets you run a second, separate copy of an app on the same phone — perfect for two accounts on one device. Each copy lives in its own isolated space, keeping your data apart.

Built from scratch for privacy and simplicity.
features: Clone an app into a second copy

apps.name: Python King
apps.description:
Python King runs Python 3.13 right on your phone, fully offline. Write and run code anywhere, learn Python on the go, and export your Python animations as MP4 video.

An ad-free pocket coding lab for students and developers.
features: Great for learning on the go

apps.name: VoltAura
apps.tagline: Premium charging animations and notification edge-glow.
apps.description:
VoltAura makes your phone feel premium with beautiful charging animations and a glowing edge effect when notifications arrive. It is light on battery and easy to set up.

A simple way to make your Android look and feel more special.

apps.name: Vaultly
apps.tagline: A clean, privacy-respecting video & music downloader and offline hub.
apps.description:
Vaultly is a tidy, privacy-respecting home for your downloaded videos and music. Save media, keep it organised in one place, and enjoy it offline — with a clean, modern look.

No clutter, no ads, and your library stays on your device.
